---
title: "manhattan plot"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load packages

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrastr)
library(dplyr)
library(scattermore)
```

Using the output from GAPIT we generate the manhattan plots:

# GWAS fabae BLINK

```{r}
# Load data
gwas <- read.csv(
  "../../../../files_too_heavy_for_git/output_gapit/Afabae/GAPIT.Association.GWAS_Results.BLINK.emmean(Kansas).csv"
)

# Replace zero p-values
gwas$P.value[gwas$P.value == 0] <- 1e-300

# Remove missing values
gwas <- na.omit(gwas)

# Convert variables
gwas$Chr  <- factor(gwas$Chr)
gwas$Pos  <- as.numeric(gwas$Pos)
gwas$logP <- -log10(gwas$P.value)

# Compute cumulative chromosome positions
chr_sizes <- gwas %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarise(chr_len = max(Pos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(offset = lag(cumsum(chr_len), default = 0))

gwas <- left_join(gwas, chr_sizes, by = "Chr")
gwas$BPcum <- gwas$Pos + gwas$offset

# Chromosome centers
axisdf <- gwas %>%
  group_by(Chr) %>%
  summarise(center = (min(BPcum) + max(BPcum)) / 2,
            .groups = "drop")

axisdf$label <- c("chr1S", "chr1L", "chr2", "chr3",
                  "chr4", "chr5", "chr6")

# Manhattan plot
p <- ggplot(
  gwas,
  aes(
    x = BPcum,
    y = logP,
    colour = factor(as.numeric(Chr) %% 2)
  )
) +
  geom_scattermore(
    pointsize = 10,
    pixels = c(3000, 2000)
  ) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("grey70", "darkred")) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(5e-8),
    colour = "grey50",
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = axisdf$center,
    labels = axisdf$label
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(
    ylim = c(0, -log10(5e-16))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = expression(-log[10](italic(P))),
    title = "Manhattan Plot A. fabae – BLINK (Kansas)"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
  )

print(p)

ggsave(
  "Manhattan_BLINK_fabae.pdf",
  p,
  width = 7,
  height = 4
)

postscript(
  "Manhattan_BLINK_fabae.eps",
  width = 7,
  height = 4,
  onefile = FALSE,
  horizontal = FALSE,
  paper = "special"
)

print(p)

dev.off()
```
